title: Hideaki Anno, Yutaka Izubuchi Co-Direct 'Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199' Anime Movie
content: An official website opened for the new Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) anime project on Tuesday, revealing its official title, main staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). Titled Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199 ( Cosmoship Yamato √2199 ), the project will be a feature-length anime movie.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hirayasumi Manga to End in 2 More Chapters
content: This year's 45th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga will end in two more chapters. If there are no delays, the manga will end on October 19.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Latest Ending Manga Reaches Its Climax With a Twist No One Saw Coming
content: Shonen Jump will be ending its fifth major series of 2026 very soon, but before that, it has incorporated a twist that perfectly matches the manga’s tone. 2026 has been an interesting year for Shonen Jump, with the magazine continuing its pattern of debuting new series while many are getting canceled as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Mackenyu Will Appear at London MCM Comic Con on October
content: The MCM London Comic Con has announced on its X/Twitter feed that the actor Mackenyu , who plays Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, will appear at the event which runs from Friday October 23 to Sunday October 25. The venue is London's ExCel Centre. Mackenyu will appear on the Saturday and Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dub of Assassination Classroom Anime Streams on YouTube
content: The first 22-episode season of the Assassination Classroom anime based on Yūsei Matsui 's manga of the same name premiered in Japan in January 2015. The second season of the anime premiered in January 2016. Muse Asia streamed the full first season of the anime in India on February 18.
author: ANN

content: Ani-One Asia announced on Monday that it has licensed the Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū , Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , and Super Psychic Policeman Chojo anime. title: Sacnilk Estimates ₹8.46 Crore Indian Box Office Collection for New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil Anime Film
content: The film opened in Indian theaters in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu on Friday. The film had a premiere screening for fans on September 26 featuring character mascots from the franchise .

title: Aniplus Asia Airs Simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox Anime
content: Aniplus Asia announced last Friday that it will air a simulcast of Raccoon Dog & Fox , the television anime based on Atamoto 's Tanuki to Kitsune (Raccoon Dog and Fox) manga. The simulcast will begin airing later today, October 5 at 8:30 p.m. GMT +8.

title: Muse India, JioHotstar Streams Hitoribocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu Anime
content: The anime premiered in April 2019. Muse India describes its story: Many of us know what it is like to transition to a new school with few to no friends in a new environment, going through the arduous process of getting to know people again.
